business_summary: Lineage Cell Therapeutics, Inc., a clinical-stage biotechnology company, developing cell replacement therapies to treat serious medical conditions in the United States and internationally. The company develops OpRegen, an allogeneic retinal pigment epithelium cell replacement therapy, which is in Phase 2a clinical trial for the treatment of the age-related macular degeneration; and OPC1, an allogeneic oligodendrocyte progenitor cell therapy that is in Phase 1/2a multicenter clinical trial for the treatment of cervical spinal cord injuries. It also offers ReSonance (ANP1), an allogeneic auditory neuron progenitor cell transplant, which is in preclinical development for the treatment of sensorineural hearing loss; and PNC1, an allogeneic photoreceptor cell transplant, which is in preclinical development for the treatment of vision loss due to photoreceptor dysfunction or damage. In addition, the company is developing RND1, a novel hypoimmune induced pluripotent stem cell line for the development of a cell transplant candidate for the potential treatment of an undisclosed indication, as well as engages in the research and development of ILT1, an allogeneic cell transplant for the treatment of Type 1 Diabetes; and LCT-CON, an allogeneic cell transplant, as well as therapeutic products for retinal diseases, neurological diseases, ophthalmology, metabolic, and disorders and oncology. The company has a collaboration agreement with William Demant Invest for the preclinical development of ReSonance (ANP1). It also has a strategic collaboration with Factor Bioscience Inc. for the development of genetically engineered iPSC line for the company to utilize for differentiation into certain cell transplant product candidates. The company was formerly known as BioTime, Inc. and changed its name to Lineage Cell Therapeutics, Inc. in August 2019. Lineage Cell Therapeutics, Inc. was incorporated in 1990 and is headquartered in Carlsbad, California.
business_summary_ko: Lineage Cell Therapeutics, Inc.는 임상 단계의 생명공학 회사로서 미국 및 국제적으로 심각한 질병을 치료하기 위한 세포 대체 치료법을 개발하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 동종 망막 색소 상피 세포 대체 요법인 OpRegen을 개발하고 있으며, 이는 연령 관련 황반변성 치료를 위한 임상 2a상 시험 단계에 있습니다. 및 경추 척수 손상 치료를 위한 다기관 임상 1/2a상 시험이 진행 중인 동종 희돌기교세포 전구세포 치료법인 OPC1이 포함됩니다. 또한 감각신경성 난청 치료를 위해 전임상 개발 중인 동종 청각 뉴런 전구세포 이식인 ReSonance(ANP1)도 제공합니다. 및 광수용체 기능 장애 또는 손상으로 인한 시력 상실 치료를 위해 전임상 개발 중인 동종 광수용체 세포 이식인 PNC1이 있습니다. 또한, 회사는 미공개 적응증의 잠재적 치료를 위한 세포이식 후보물질 개발을 위해 새로운 저면역 유도만능줄기세포주인 RND1을 개발하고 있으며, 치료를 위한 동종이계 세포이식인 ILT1의 연구개발에도 참여하고 있습니다.
